units.source_text: 两人结婚多年，膝下尚无子女，感到美中不足。

en.t: The two had been married for many years, but they still had no children, and felt that this left their happiness incomplete.

units.source_text: 亲王常常说：“但愿有个可爱的孩子，以慰寂寞无聊的生涯。”

en.t: The prince often said, "If only we had a dear child to comfort this lonely, empty life."

units.source_text: 事有凑巧，不久果然生了一位美丽的女公子。

en.t: As luck would have it, before long a beautiful little princess was indeed born.

units.source_text: 亲王夫妇无限宠爱，尽心竭力地抚育她。

en.t: The prince and his wife loved her without measure and devoted all their care to raising her.
In the meantime, the lady unexpectedly became pregnant again.

units.source_text: 大家指望这回要生男儿了，岂知生下来的又是一位女公子。

en.t: Everyone hoped that this time a boy would be born, but the child who arrived was another little princess.

units.source_text: 但夫人产中调理失慎，生起病来，日重一日，竟致一命呜呼。

en.t: But the lady was not properly cared for during childbirth, fell ill, grew worse day by day, and at last passed away.

units.source_text: 亲王遭此意外之变，茫然不知所措。

en.t: Faced with this unexpected calamity, the prince was stunned and did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 他想：“我年来生存于世，痛苦难堪之事甚多。

en.t: He thought, "Through all my years in this world, there have been so many painful and unbearable things.

units.source_text: 只因有这个难于抛舍的美人牵惹我心，就被绊住在这世间，因循度日。

en.t: Only because this beloved beauty, so hard to abandon, held my heart was I bound to this world and went on passing my days.

units.source_text: 如今只剩我一人残留在世间，痛苦定然更多了。

en.t: Now that I alone remain in the world, my suffering will surely only grow greater.

units.source_text: 教我一人抚育这两个女孩，则因身份所关，不成体统，外间传闻也不好听。”

en.t: For me to raise these two girls by myself would be improper for someone of my rank, and the rumors outside would not sound good either."

units.source_text: 便想乘此机会，成遂出家本愿。

en.t: So he thought he would take this opportunity to fulfill his long-held wish to renounce the world.

units.source_text: 然而两个女孩无人可托，弃下她们十分可怜，因此踌躇不决地过了许多年月。

en.t: However, there was no one to whom he could entrust the two girls, and it seemed terribly pitiful to leave them behind, so many years passed while he remained undecided.

units.source_text: 其间两位女公子日渐长大，都生得花容月貌。

en.t: During that time, the two young princesses gradually grew up, and both became exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 亲王朝夕以此自慰，不知不觉地度送岁月。

en.t: The prince took comfort in this morning and evening, and before he knew it the years slipped by.
